requirements.text: Preserve the original four-state scan verdict and embed the original receipt in advice.
Missing, changed or tampered source/evidence/time requires fresh context before investigation.
An incomplete current-time database evaluation must remain incomplete and must not invoke scanners.
Only bounded offline investigation advice is produced; no scanner command, waiver, inference or automatic approval.

limits: Unit advice routing controls are not real scanner results.
Current-time stale database stops before scanner execution.
No ASVS certification or application release approval.
